fields.statement: Verifier at a47ea982 (leaf commits cd5fe1a5, a47ea982). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(change-worktree-unique-slug|arbiter-agent-tabs)$' passed: two change sets titled 'Twin work' get worktrees repo.twin-work and repo.twin-work-01m5pwgjc82p and branches cs/twin-work and cs/twin-work-01m5pwgjc82p (12 lowercased ID characters, not the 9-character short ID), and run start --dry-run (existing and --new plan) predicts the suffixed worktree. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestUniqueSlugShipTargetAndAbandon passed: findShipTarget names the later change set's suffixed slug/branch/worktree, and abandonCleanup names cs/twin-work-<suffix>, never cs/twin-work. Full go test -trimpath -timeout 40m ./internal/api passed (416s; an earlier run hit the default 10m timeout under load ~10) and ./internal/session passed. grep for 'Slug(' in non-test Go: session.Slug is called only inside session.ChangeSetSlug; change worktree, run start/dry run (newPlanChange), leaf/check/fix/agent prompts (t.slug), ship target and abandon cleanup all use ChangeSetSlug.
